items.title: Newmont (NEM) Stock Looks Reasonable Following Its 252% Three Year Run
items.summary: Newmont has logged striking share gains in recent years, and the question now is whether the current US$119.96 price is properly grounded in the cash the miner can generate. After a run like this, valuation arguments tend to get louder than usual. Newmont has returned 252.2% over the past 3 years, which puts a lot of pressure on the underlying cash flows to justify that kind of move.
